title.narrative: National Programme for Tuberculosis Control and Chest Disease - Sri Lanka (01-Jan-2019-31-Dec-2021)

description.narrative: Sri Lanka, Tuberculosis, Ministry of Health and Mass Media of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka (MOH)This program has the following goals: Decrease the prevalence of TB by 10% by 2020 based on the WHO estimates of TB burden in 2014. The objectives of this program are: To improve the TB control by detecting at least 80% of incident TB cases (all forms) by 2017 and 90% of incident cases by 2020. To improve the outcome of enrolled TB patients: a) By achieving 90% treatment success rate of all forms of non MDR TB patients; and b) To maintain at least 75% treatment success rate among MDR TB cases by 2017 and 90% by 2021. To integrate TB control activities in the general healthcare system by establishing TB diagnostic and treatment services in 40% of all hospitals up to the level of divisional hospitals type B or above by 2017 and 80% by 2020. To improve the accessibility to TB treatment and care by engaging 30% of all private health care providers (Hospitals and General practitioners) in TB control by 2017 and 50% by 2020. Ensure the quality TB services in line with current international standards are provided by qualified and regular supervised personnel at 100% of all implementation sites by 2017

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for LKA-T-MOHP02
RR-TB and/or MDR-TB prevalence among new TB patients: Proportion of new TB patients with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB
Outcome indicators targets and results for LKA-T-MOHP02

TB treatment coverage: Percentage of patients with new and relapse TB that were notified and treated among the estimated number of incident TB in the same year (all forms of TB - bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for LKA-T-MOHP02
Number of TB cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB notified
Number of children <5 in contact with TB patients who began isonizide preventive therapy
Number of notified cases of all forms of TB (i.e. bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed), new and relapse cases

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of TB cases, all forms, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB cases registered for treatment during a specified period, new and relapse cases
Number of cases with RR-TB and/or MDR-TB that began second-line treatment
